description: Ex Indonesian Air Force Hawk Mk 53, returned to its makers for display. Marked Ex TNI-AU. At the BAE Systems Brough factory site, the birthplace of the Blackburn and Hawk designs; LL-5313 stands as the gate guardian and is visible from the public road. Last confirmed present Dec 2019.
